one_line: Afro-Indian admiral of Janjira’s navy, linked to the living Siddi coastal communities.

appearance.age_look: late 30s, tall and athletic with a seasoned sailor’s build
appearance.face: oval face with deep brown complexion, high cheekbones, broad nose, full lips, slightly arched brows, and a calm but alert default expression that hints at calculation and quiet authority
appearance.hair: tight black curls kept short on the sides with a slightly fuller top, mostly hidden under a dark indigo Mughal-style turban wrapped low and practical, with a thin rust-red cloth band and a small simple metal brooch at the front
appearance.costume: knee-length, long-sleeved cotton angarkha in deep indigo with subtle vertical weave lines, tied to the side with rust-red fabric cords, worn over loose cream churidar trousers; a sleeveless padded waistcoat in muted sea-green cotton, slightly quilted for light protection, sits over the angarkha; around his waist a broad rust-red cotton sash is tightly wrapped and knotted to one side, with the end hanging down to mid-thigh; on his feet simple brown leather mojari-style shoes with modest upturned toes; he wears a short, well-used brown leather belt over the sash to secure his weapon, and small silver hoop earrings plus a single plain silver ring on his right hand hint at coastal connections without looking royal or ostentatious
appearance.signature: a slightly curved Indo-Arabic naval sabre with a simple iron hilt wrapped in dark brown leather, worn sheathed at his left hip; the wooden scabbard is stained dark, with two plain brass bands and subtle salt stains suggesting years at sea

ref_desc: Siddi Yaqut Khan is a late-30s Afro-Indian admiral with a deep brown oval face, short tight black curls under a dark indigo turban, wearing an indigo angarkha, sea-green waistcoat, cream churidar, rust-red sash and brown shoes, carrying a dark-curved naval sabre.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body shonen-anime style character of Siddi Yaqut Khan as a historically grounded late-17th-century Janjira naval leader: a tall, athletic Afro-Indian man in his late 30s with a deep brown oval face, high cheekbones, broad nose, full lips, and a calm but alert expression. His hair is tight black curls kept short, largely covered by a dark indigo Mughal-style turban with a thin rust-red band and a small simple metal brooch. He wears a knee-length, long-sleeved deep indigo cotton angarkha with subtle vertical weave lines, tied at the side with rust-red cords, under a sleeveless muted sea-green padded waistcoat that looks lightly quilted. His trousers are loose cream churidar, gathered at the ankles, and he has a broad rust-red cotton sash wrapped firmly around his waist with one end hanging to mid-thigh, plus a brown leather belt over the sash. On his feet are brown leather mojari-style shoes with modest upturned toes. Add small silver hoop earrings and one plain silver ring on his right hand. At his left hip, show his signature curved Indo-Arabic naval sabre in a dark wooden scabbard with plain brass bands and worn salt stains. Use a palette dominated by deep indigo, rust red, cream, sea green, and dark brown, and pose him in a neutral, steady stance suitable for a character model sheet, clearly showing face, turban, full outfit, and sabre.
